_note: Example app-author fixtures for dsx-test (run: `node packages/kernel/bin/dsx-test.ts` from OpenSource/Web — no args sweeps the whole repo). Same shape as the actions corpus: each case seeds `scope` into a FRESH store, runs `run` through the REAL ActionRunner (the same execution path the corpus gates), then asserts `expectStore` paths under JSE equality (a JSON null means absent/nil) and `expectEvents` order. Copy this file next to your own component as <name>.dsxtest.json and edit. Money rides as integer cents on purpose — doubles cannot hold big decimals exactly (see proposals/jse-platform.md, appendix A).

seed.body: dsx.action.addItem({ sku: 'tea', price: 450, qty: 2 }); dsx.action.addItem({ sku: 'mug', price: 1200, qty: 1 })

addItem.body: dsx.variable.cart.push({ sku: sku, price: price, qty: qty }); dsx.action.total()

total.body: dsx.variable.total = dsx.variable.cart.reduce((sum, it) => sum + it.price * it.qty, 0)

removeItem.body: dsx.variable.cart = dsx.variable.cart.filter(it => it.sku !== sku); dsx.action.total(); dsx.event('removed', { left: dsx.variable.cart.length })

total.body: dsx.variable.total = dsx.variable.cart.reduce((sum, it) => sum + it.price * it.qty, 0)
